content.title: Where to watch Lakers vs. Warriors NBA game for free today
content.text: Golden State Warriors guard Stephen Curry (30) reacts during the second half of an NBA basketball game Orlando Magic, Monday, Dec. 22, 2025, in San Francisco (AP Photo/Justine Willard)APIf you purchase a product through a link on our site, we may receive compensation.By Thomas Lagrone | tlagrone@al.comThe Los Angeles Lakers play against the Golden State Warriors in an NBA game today. The matchup is scheduled to begin at 9 p.m. CT on Prime Video. Fans can watch this game for free online by using the free trial offered by Prime Video. The Lakers will have to play without their star players Austin Reaves and Luka Doncic today, as both players are dealing with injuries. The two players combine to average 55 points per game, so the Lakers will be missing a lot of offense this evening. The Los Angeles squad is fighting for a top three seed in the Western Conference, as the team trails Denver by one game. In order to win the NBA game today, the Lakers will need great performances from their role players. The Warriors enter this matchup with a 37-42 record, and they have lost four of their last five games.In order to bounce back today, the Warriors will need to rely on their star guard Stephen Curry. He is currently averaging 27 points per game, and he is shooting nearly 40% from three-point range. Fans can watch this NBA game for free online by using the free trial offered by Prime Video.
